stops.stop: Bergthorshvoll, the knoll under grass
stops.date_confidence: present day. The site is identified by unbroken local tradition and farm continuity, not by documentary proof from the burning itself. No memorial stone at the site, and no folklore or hauntings attached to it, could be confirmed from any source reached; both are gaps rather than negations. The Icelandic Saga Centre at nearby Hvolsvollur could not be verified: sagacentre.is failed DNS resolution.
